title: DamageType
description: Schema for a compendium DamageType entry (Rpg/Health/DamageType.cs). The compendium file should be a JSON object whose keys are DamageType IDs.

name.description: Human-readable name of the damage type (e.g. 'Slash', 'Burn', 'Blunt').

parent.description: ID or name of the parent DamageType this type derives from. Used for inheritance checks via IsDerivedFrom(). Leave empty or null for root types.

injury.description: Compendium ID of the InjuryType this damage type causes by default. If omitted or not found, the compendium's default InjuryType is used.

color.description: Color used in UI for this damage type. Accepts '#RRGGBB' hex format or a .NET named color (e.g. 'Red', 'DarkOrange').
